gpt-scrambler.name: GPT Scrambler
gpt-scrambler.core_function_original: GPT Scrambler helps people turn AI drafts into writing that sounds human. Students use it to polish essays, content writers and marketers to get natural copy in the right tone, and developers to plug it into their workflow via API and MCP. Paste text from ChatGPT, Claude or any LLM and get readable, detector-passing writing in seconds, in 20+ languages. It saves hours of manual rewriting. Free to try, with a web app, Chrome extension and built-in Essay Writer.
gpt-scrambler.value_proposition_original: Turn AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing in seconds. Paste from ChatGPT, Claude or any LLM, skip hours of manual rewriting, and get results that read well and pass major AI detectors.
gpt-scrambler.problem_solved_original: GPT Scrambler solves the problem that AI-written text is fast to produce but often unusable as it is. It tends to sound robotic and generic, and AI detectors like Turnitin, GPTZero and Copyleaks can flag it. Rewriting it by hand takes hours, so the tool does that rewrite in seconds.

airix.name: AIRIX
airix.core_function_original: AIRIX is an AI visibility platform for small and local businesses, and for the agencies that serve them. People increasingly ask AI chatbots for recommendations ("best dentist in Leeds", "top accountant near me"), and if the assistant doesn't name you, you don't get the call. AIRIX checks how often ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 12 other AI platforms recommend your business, scores your visibility, and shows which competitors they name instead and which sources they cite.
airix.target_customers_original: Small and local businesses seeking more recommendations and leads from AI search, plus revenue teams monitoring AI visibility.
airix.value_proposition_original: AIRIX scans 16 AI platforms to show businesses where they are recommended, which competitors are mentioned, and what actions can improve their AI visibility.
airix.problem_solved_original: Businesses lack visibility into whether AI chatbots recommend them, which competitors they favor, and how to improve their chances of being mentioned.

back-in-stock-now.value_proposition_original: Get an alert the minute a sold-out gift is back on a Target shelf near you, at the store price.
